lines: Rising seven-hundreds with-eight sixty since indeed he; this cakra-rising spoken of sādhakas beneficial.
l4.sanskrit_cite: udayaḥ saptaśatikā sāṣṭā ṣaṣṭiryato hi saḥ eṣa cakrodayaḥ proktaḥ sādhakānāṃ hitāvahaḥ
